parameters.content:
## 🚨 SAV Alert & Ticketing

**Trigger**: Webhook POST 'sav-alert'
**Flow**: Réception → Normalize → Create ticket → Build alert → Execute alert

parameters.query: INSERT INTO sav_requests (store_id, order_id, customer_id, type, status, description, request_number, created_at) VALUES ({{ $json.store_id }}, {{ $json.order_id || 'NULL' }}, {{ $json.customer_id || 'NULL' }}, '{{ $json.type }}', 'open', '{{ $json.description }}', 'SAV-' || to_char(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), NOW());

parameters.jsCode:
const d = $('Build Alert').first().json;
return [{ json: { success: true, severity: d.severity, type: d.type, alert_created: d.has_alert } }];

parameters.query: INSERT INTO analytics_events (store_id, event_type, payload, created_at) VALUES (1, 'workflow_error', '{"workflow": "sav_alert_ticketing", "error": "{{ $json.message }}"}'::jsonb, NOW())
